Title: Skeleton I
Comparison: Distant hills and landscape are omitted; the spade and the ground beneath the skeleton remain. The omitted scenery offers a way to compare the body’s relation to its environment.

Title: Skeleton II
Change tags: Landscape / setting; Omitted; Retained; Text / labels
Comparison: The pedestal and skull remain, but the pedestal inscription “Vivitur ingenio, caetera mortis erunt” is absent from this plate. The surrounding plants and ground also change. The missing words can be considered alongside the missing landscape; this does not establish that the words disappeared from the whole book.

Title: Muscle I
Comparison: Buildings, a town and the distant setting behind the figure are substantially omitted. The body and a small patch of ground remain.

Title: Muscle II
Comparison: Trees, architecture and distant scenery are omitted, while the ground beneath the body is simplified.

Title: Muscle III
Comparison: Trees, settlement and distant scenery are omitted. A more open field surrounds the anatomical figure.

Title: Muscle IV
Comparison: Distant buildings and terrain are omitted. Some foreground plants and ground remain or are redrawn.

Title: Muscle V
Comparison: Large architectural, rocky and landscape elements are omitted. Smaller areas of ground and vegetation remain.

Title: Muscle VI
Comparison: Architecture, rocks and distant scenery are omitted, weakening the figure’s visual connection to its surrounding environment.

Title: Muscle VII
Comparison: The beam, rope and supporting apparatus remain. Ground, plants and the surrounding setting are simplified. This example makes it possible to ask which supporting objects are retained.

Title: Muscle VIII
Comparison: The brick wall and column remain as supports, while surrounding scenery and ground details are simplified. This is not a case in which every background element disappears.

Title: Muscle IX
Comparison: Extended distant buildings and terrain are omitted, leaving the anatomical figure more isolated.

Title: Muscle X
Comparison: The bridge, buildings and extended distant view are omitted. A local patch of ground remains beneath the body.

Title: Muscle XI

Title: Muscle XII
Comparison: Distant scenery is substantially reduced. The body and a local patch of ground remain.

Title: Muscle XIII
Comparison: Ruins and trees are omitted. Parts of the supporting structures and ground remain or are redrawn.

Title: Muscle XIV
Comparison: The seat and supporting structure remain. Ground, rocks and plants are locally redrawn. The changes are selective; the whole setting should not be treated as deleted.

Title: Male & female figures
Comparison: Male and female figures appearing on separate Epitome pages are combined on one plate. The skull held by the male figure is replaced by an apple; a skull and snake appear on the ground. These changes alter the image’s reading cues as well as its composition.
